keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «달의 모양(위상)은 햇빛을 받는 면을 우리가 얼마나 보느냐에 따라 달라진다(주제)» 와 «달이 지구 주위를 돌면서 밝은 절반을 여러 각도에서 보게 된다(이유)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (the phases depend on how much of the sunlit side we can see) and the reason (as the moon travels around the Earth, we see the bright half from different angles). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why does the moon shine at night?
opts: Because it reflects light from the sun
Because it makes its own light
Because it is very close to the Earth
evs: Instead, it shines because it reflects light from the sun.
The moon seems to change shape during the month, but its shape never really changes.
This whole cycle takes about 29 and a half days, and then the pattern starts again.
As the moon keeps moving, we see more of the bright side each night.
why: 달은 스스로 빛을 내지 않고, 태양의 빛을 반사하기 때문에 빛난다고 했어요.
The moon does not make its own light. It shines because it reflects light from the sun.

qs.q: In "These different shapes, called phases," what does "phases" mean?
qs.qko: «These different shapes, called phases» 에서 «phases» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: The different shapes the moon seems to have
The light that comes from the sun
The path the moon travels around the Earth
evs: These different shapes, called phases, depend on how much of the moon's sunlit side we can see.
The sun always lights up half of the moon.
Instead, it shines because it reflects light from the sun.
This whole cycle takes about 29 and a half days, and then the pattern starts again.
why: «이 다양한 모양을 위상(phases)이라고 부른다» 고 했으니, phases 는 달이 바뀌어 보이는 여러 모양이에요.
The text says «these different shapes» are «called phases», so phases are the shapes the moon seems to have.

qs.q: Why can’t we see the moon at a new moon?
qs.qko: 삭(신월) 때는 왜 달을 볼 수 없나요?
opts: The sun lights the half of the moon that is facing away from us
The moon stops reflecting light for a few days
The moon becomes much smaller than before
evs: The sun always lights up half of the moon.
When the Earth is between the sun and the moon, we see the whole bright side, which is a full moon.
When the moon is between the Earth and the sun, we cannot see its bright side, so we call it a new moon.
This whole cycle takes about 29 and a half days, and then the pattern starts again.
why: 태양은 언제나 달의 절반을 비추는데, 달이 지구와 태양 사이에 있으면 그 밝은 면을 볼 수 없다고 했어요. 두 문장을 이으면 밝은 면이 우리 반대쪽을 향한다는 것을 알 수 있어요.
The sun always lights up half of the moon, and when the moon is between the Earth and the sun, we cannot see its bright side. Together they show the bright half faces away from us.

ends: Why does the moon always show us the same side?
달은 왜 우리에게 늘 같은 면만 보여 줄까요?
The Same Side of the Moon
What would it be like to live on the moon?

write.src: “Let’s <u>look at the moon tonight</u> before <u>it becomes a full moon</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we should do together and what happens after that.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «무엇이 + 어떻게 되는지» 를 넣어 때를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: before the sun goes down)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write what + what happens to make the time clear. (e.g. before the sun goes down)
